== Exact published English Set 11 text ==
The Gold Effect deploys on a system, suppresses opposing generation bonuses there and charges opponent an additional character-based battle cost. The remaster deploys on Emperor, changes Jedi power and deploy, and causes Force loss in the opponent’s move phase under its presence conditions.
